items.question: Which old free-text spellings count as known statuses on read besides the exact enum values?
items.ticket: Sandbox status is stored as free text (draft, Draft, in-review...), so filters miss tasks.
items.chose: Only "in review" (after cleaning) is mapped to review; every other non-enum value is unreadable.
items.instead: Map more aliases (for example "in progress", "done", "approved") or make the alias table configurable.

items.question: How is a stored value cleaned before it is matched on read (case, whitespace, separators)?
items.ticket: Existing values are normalised when read
items.chose: Lowercases, turns every run of whitespace, "-" and "_" into one space, and trims, so "in-review", "In_Review" and "-merged_" all read.
items.instead: Only trim and lowercase, and treat hyphen or underscore variants as unreadable. Or treat "-" and "_" as removable and not as spaces.

items.question: What does reading an unrecognised, empty or whitespace-only stored value return?
items.chose: Returns null and does not guess the nearest status.
items.instead: Throw an error, or fall back to a default such as draft.

items.question: Does writing a status normalise a near-miss such as "Draft", " draft" or the old "in-review"?
items.chose: Writes only exact lowercase enum values and does no cleaning or aliasing.
items.instead: Normalise the input with the read logic first, then write the canonical value.

items.question: How does writing an invalid status fail?
items.chose: Throws a plain Error whose message quotes the value as given.
items.instead: Return null or a result object, or throw a custom or typed error.

items.question: What does a bulk read do with rows whose status cannot be read?
items.chose: Keeps the row with status null and does not drop it or throw.
items.instead: Drop the unreadable rows, or throw on the first one.

items.question: How does a bulk read report unreadable values: the raw stored text or the cleaned text, and are duplicates collapsed?
items.chose: Collects the raw stored strings in a Set, so each distinct raw value appears once and "Alpha", "alpha" and "  Alpha " are kept separate.
items.instead: Report cleaned values, or report ids or counts, or keep duplicates.

items.question: In what order does a bulk read return the unreadable values and the rows?
items.chose: Rows keep input order. Unreadable values are sorted with the default string sort, which compares UTF-16 code units, so uppercase sorts before lowercase.
items.instead: List unreadable values in first-seen order, or sort case-insensitively or by locale.

items.question: What does a bulk read return for empty input?
items.chose: Returns empty rows and an empty unreadable list.
